rationale: Both candidates miss the ground truth's most concrete, reproduced bugs (defaults regression at :780, model_subdir/tokenizer_subdir loss at :1354, omni_kv_config precedence flip at :1275); X's 'Validated' section actively asserts those exact spots are correct (precedence preserved, batch-default deferral works), directly contradicting the human reviewer's reproductions — a real accuracy problem even though it sits outside the scored findings list. Y independently converges on the same code regions as GT items 2/5/6 (ownership-validation gaps, parity-test blind spots) with its own live reproductions across dozens of pipelines, and explicitly ran the test suite and self-corrected a candidate finding as 'not a regression,' showing more disciplined verification. Both sets of findings are well-grounded and actionable with file/line citations and concrete fixes, but Y's higher thematic overlap with GT plus its reproduction rigor gives it a clear edge in recall and trustworthiness.
